name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A small step or line chart sized by its container: a step line through the points exactly as given, or, with a direction, the best value so far derived from them (the running maximum when larger is better, the running minimum when smaller is); or a plain line through every point. Optional dots at records or every point, a dashed reference line, an area wash, and an accessible name from the host. The line takes the current text colour.
